description: Read the estate's financial ledger — money in (receipts), money out (disbursements), and distributions to heirs. Returns: `transactions` (each with `paid_by` already resolved to the actual payer's NAME — use it as-is, never assume the executor paid), `starting_balances` (bank accounts' date-of-death balances that already show in the ledger as starting-balance lines — these are NOT missing transactions; do not suggest re-adding them), and `totals` (starting_balance, money_in, money_out, pending_reimbursements). Use this before answering any spending, reimbursement, or accounting question, and treat both `transactions` and `starting_balances` as already in the ledger.

direction.description: Optional filter: 'receipt' (money in), 'disbursement' (money out / expenses), or 'distribution' (paid to heirs).

estate_id.description: The estate to act on. Call list_my_estates first to get this id.
